reasoning: On the season so far the Hornets are the stronger team; with home court the Hornets start about 2 points better, in a game of about 218 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hornets (revenge).
Bottom line: the Hornets win 65 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 191 and 240 total points.
